solver_separation: consume supplied Berry rows only; no MPB, eigensolver, Wilson loop, Berry calculation, recovery, or adaptive retry
status_cardinality: exactly one terminal status per sample_id and band: QUALIFIED_REPORTED or NOT_REPORTED_WITH_REASON
incomplete_policy: any NOT_REPORTED_WITH_REASON yields INCOMPLETE_NOT_REPORTED with FLUX_Q and VALLEY_CHERN not emitted
